ministry: Ministry of Land and Infrastructure, Government of India
slide1Desc: Streamlining land acquisition, verification, and administrative approvals securely across all government tiers.
slide2Desc: Empowering industrial development with digitized survey mapping, clear ownership tracking, and seamless multi-department coordination.
slide3Desc: Bypassing traditional bottlenecks with centralized state authority reviews, automated document verification, and instant tracking.
section1Desc: DHARA connects different administrative tiers through one secure unified land information system.
section1SubDesc: Companies initiate projects, government authorities manage the administrative lifecycle, and landowners access transparent land status.
portal1Desc: A project-facing view for organisations requiring land for infrastructure and development.
portal2Desc: The connected government layer through which district, field, state and central responsibilities operate.
portal3Desc: A simpler public-facing view helping people understand what is happening with their land.
lawLibraryDesc: Official legislation and rules relevant to project authorities preparing land acquisition proposals.
section2Desc: A neutral geographic reference map. Project markers appear only inside authorised review workflows.
modalSub: Choose your specific official role to sign into the secure portal.
role1Desc: Review proposals, coordinate verification and manage district-level administrative decisions.
role2Desc: Verify parcels on the ground, capture evidence and update field observations.
role3Desc: Monitor districts, identify delays and oversee project progress across the state.
role4Desc: Monitor national progress, compare states and identify systemic delays.
section3Desc: Every project follows a transparent sequence of administrative and verification decisions.
section3SubDesc: A step-by-step audit trail showing the active stage, responsible government authority, and next action.
